_contract: QUAL-07's per-query judgement declarations. Each query is compared
under the STRICTEST class its semantics allow, decided here in
advance with the reason written down - a class chosen after seeing
a diff is a gate bent to pass. Downgrading a query's class during a
run makes that run INCONCLUSIVE.
mode append: every output row is final; the drained kafka-sink
topics compare as normalised sorted multisets, byte-exact.
mode materialised: the query emits an update stream, so emit
cadence and revision count are implementation detail; each
engine's upsert topic reduces to final state (last write per key,
tombstones removed) and the states compare BY KEY. variant is
'upsert' because an updating result cannot land in an append
Kafka sink on either engine.
tol_fields/epsilon: named float fields compare within an absolute
epsilon; everything undeclared stays exact. Every epsilon here is
1e-6, covering RENDERING only (two engines legitimately print the
same IEEE double differently): in this dataset every declared
float is either a per-record product or a mean whose partial sums
are integer-valued doubles far below 2^53, so the VALUES are
order-independent and IEEE-identical - a genuine numeric
divergence is orders of magnitude above 1e-6 and still fails.

q1.reason: Per-record projection; price = 0.908 * price is IEEE-identical on both engines, epsilon covers rendering; auction, bidder, datetime exact.

q2.reason: Expression filter plus integer projection; every column exact.

q3.reason: Equi-join of two insert-only streams emits inserts only; strings and integers exact.

q4.reason: Unbounded GROUP BY revises one row per category. Both engines average over DOUBLE (the cast premise is reconciled in the shared definition); the partial sums are integer-valued doubles below 2^53, so the mean is order-independent and epsilon covers rendering only.

q5.reason: Top-1 per hop window revises its window's single row as panes arrive. The rank order (num DESC, auction ASC) is total, so the winner is defined; all output columns integers, exact.

q7.reason: Windowed MAX/MIN; each pane is final at the watermark; integers exact.

q11.reason: Session counts per bidder; sessions close at the watermark and emit once; integers exact.

qhop.reason: Hop counts per auction; each of the five overlapping panes is final; integers exact.

qhopv.reason: qhop with the window start projected. The pk exists for the row-count harness's value gate; here append is the STRICTER judgement (the full pane multiset, not just the folded state), so it is the one used.

qcum.reason: Cumulate panes are final at each step; integers exact.

q14.reason: Same float product as q1, epsilon covers rendering; the CASE-derived bidtimetype string and the integers exact.

q15.reason: COUNT plus two COUNT(DISTINCT) per tumbling window; integers exact.

q16.reason: The q15 shape keyed by channel; string and integers exact.

q17.reason: Five aggregates per auction per pane, panes final. avgp is a double mean with integer-valued partial sums below 2^53 (the AVG cast premise is reconciled in the shared definition, as q4), so the value is order-independent and epsilon covers rendering; total, minp, maxp exact.

q18.reason: Dedup-latest revises one row per (bidder, auction). The order is made total in the shared definition (datetime, price, url), so the retained bid is defined; all columns exact.

q19.reason: Top-10 per auction retracts as higher bids arrive, so the topic carries tombstones the state reduction resolves. The order was made total on 2026-07-28 (price, datetime, bidder); all columns exact.

q20.reason: Bid expanded with its auction's itemname; insert-only join emits inserts only; string and integers exact.

q21.reason: Per-record CASE over the channel string; every column exact.

q22.reason: Per-record SPLIT_INDEX of the url; every column exact.
